section.title: Subagents & task board
section.subtitle: How many levels of teammates, how many at once, turns each, whether models can be picked, whether they may ask you for approval, plus the task board and team mode
field.allowDelegation.label: Let the model hand out work to teammates on its own
field.allowDelegation.help: With this off the subagent / team_message tools are withdrawn along with their prompts; teammates already running finish their current turn.
field.maxTeammates.label: Teammates at once per session
field.maxTeammates.help: The concurrency cap for each session; finished teammates do not count. When it is full, new work is refused outright instead of queued.
field.maxDepth.label: Recursion depth
field.maxDepth.help: 0 = only the main session can spawn teammates and a lead cannot spawn further; 1 = a lead can spawn teammates, and those teammates cannot; 2 = teammates may spawn too (team mode).
field.teamMode.label: Team mode (allow two-level delegation)
field.teamMode.help: When on, Recursion depth is raised to 2 so the pm role can spawn its own teammates; concurrency and turn budgets still apply. Meant to be used with the pm / architect / developer / tester / ops built-in roles. Turning it off does not lower the depth again.
field.maxTurns.label: Turn limit
field.maxTurns.help: 0 = unlimited (the default). Otherwise the stricter of this and the role's own budget wins: a role file with an explicit max-turns wins, and a role without one uses its entry under Default turn budgets below. With a limit, the last turn gets no tools and is asked to wrap up.
group.turns.title: Default turn budgets
group.turns.description: How many model requests each built-in role may make when it starts (0 = unlimited). A role file with an explicit max-turns wins; when the global Turn limit is above 0, the stricter one applies.
field.roleTurns.label: {role} default turns
field.roleTurns.help: Used when the role file has no max-turns; 0 = unlimited.
save.badTurns: Turns must be an integer from 0 to 200, got {value}
field.approval.label: Whether teammates may request approval
field.approval.help: This is a ceiling: an approval setting in a role file can only be stricter, never looser.
option.approval.forbid: No: actions needing approval fail and are noted in the report
option.approval.foreground: Foreground teammates only, meaning the ones whose result is being awaited
option.approval.ask: Yes, and the approval card names the teammate
field.notify.label: How background teammates report back
option.notify.auto: The report joins the lead's next turn automatically
option.notify.quiet: Written to the session only; the model sees it on the next exchange
group.models.title: Teammate models
group.models.description: When off, teammates use the role file's model / effort, or follow the current session. When on, the agent may pick a model for new teammates, but only from the authorized list below; changes only affect teammates created afterwards.
field.allowModelSelection.label: Let the agent choose models for teammates
field.allowModelSelection.help: Off (the default): spawning cannot specify a model or thinking effort. On: spawn may pass model / effort, but the model must be one of the models checked below.
field.allowedModels.label: Authorized models
field.allowedModels.help: Grouped by provider. Only the checked models may be chosen when spawning. With none checked the switch above cannot be enabled. The list follows the providers on the Models page.
save.needAllowedModel: Select at least one model before saving (or turn off “Let the agent choose models for teammates”)
field.rolesDir.label: Roles directory
field.rolesDir.help: Built-in roles: {names}. Editing files only affects teammates created afterwards.
field.newRole.label: Create a sample role
field.newRole.help: Creates starter.md in the roles directory to edit as a reference.
group.board.title: Task board
group.board.description: A shared per-session to-do list: register, claim, close, and write progress or blockers; teammates and the main model see the same board, and teammates can talk to each other directly with team_message.
field.board.label: Enable the shared task board (team_task tool)
field.board.help: With this off the model gets no team_task tool and no board prompt; the roster, delegation, reports and team_message keep working.
field.boardDir.label: Board folder
field.boardDir.help: One board per session (<session id>.json), so switching sessions switches boards.
field.clearBoard.label: Clear this session's board
field.clearBoard.help: Clears only the tasks of the current session; other sessions and teammate run records are untouched.
action.clearBoard: Cleared this session's board ({count} entries removed)
save.unknownKey: This section has no such setting: {key}
action.roleWritten: Wrote {file}; edit and save it, and it can be given work
